entries.title: Launch reference by @achxvi
entries.author: achxvi
entries.prompt_text: Produce a 15-second promo for {PRODUCT} ({ONE_LINE_PITCH}) in a stark 1-bit print style: pure white canvas, dithered and halftone black illustrations, a dithered mascot that slides in, and tiny monospace labels in the corners with a running timecode and scene tags such as '// 01 — hook'. Structure it as hook, problem, product and call to action, with crisp type reveals and hard cuts on the beat. Assemble it as a Remotion project (1920×1080, 30 fps) and add punchy sound design synthesized in code.

entries.title: Launch reference by @VictorTaelin
entries.author: VictorTaelin
entries.prompt_text: Produce a 90-second intro film for the programming language {LANGUAGE_NAME}, whose big idea is {KEY_IDEA}. Fade up from black into drifting code glyphs, reveal the name with a bold typographic moment, then explain the idea through animated code snippets, a checker catching a bug before it runs, and a performance sequence with parallel threads racing across a GPU. Build it as a deterministic HTML canvas animation with a pulsing synthesized score, capture frames with headless Chrome and encode 1440×1080 with ffmpeg.

entries.title: Launch reference by @gauravsbuilding
entries.author: gauravsbuilding
entries.prompt_text: Act as a top motion design studio and make a 15-second launch video for {PRODUCT}, {ONE_LINE_PITCH}. Open on a dark, film-grain background, then move through a tight sequence: logo build, kinetic headline type, interface panels snapping into place and one hero product shot, all on spring easing and locked to the beat. Work in Remotion, render drafts, study the frames, and keep refining timing and polish before the final pass. Score it with synthesized music and sound effects, 1920×1080 at 60 fps.

entries.title: Launch reference by @israelfemiojo
entries.author: israelfemiojo
entries.prompt_text: Make a 40-second animated launch video for {PRODUCT} starring a cute flame mascot, built with SVG and GSAP in one HTML file. The flame warms up, deadlifts a barbell, flexes and bounces between short title cards that reveal {FEATURE_1} and {FEATURE_2}, ending on the logo. Use flat vector shapes, soft ground shadows, squash-and-stretch and warm colors on a white background. Add a punchy synthesized soundtrack, render frames with headless Chrome and encode 1920×1080 at 30 fps with ffmpeg.

entries.title: Launch reference by @anthonyriera
entries.author: anthonyriera
entries.prompt_text: Design a mascot-led, 50-second launch video for {PRODUCT} ({ONE_LINE_PITCH}) in Remotion. Invent the mascot: a spiky orange pixel creature with dot eyes that pops onto a black screen and reacts to each beat of the story. Move from the problem to the product's key screens to the results with crisp white typography, smooth UI motion and a strict black, white and orange palette, closing on the logo and URL. Add a synthesized soundtrack and render 1920×1080 at 30 fps.

entries.title: Launch reference by @op7418
entries.author: op7418
entries.prompt_text: Read the codebase of {PRODUCT} and turn it into a 50-second promo film in Remotion. Reuse the app's real components, color palette, fonts and logo, write a short tagline and headline cards yourself, and animate the actual interface: windows gliding in, prompts typing, agent panels opening and results appearing, all on a dark stage with a soft planet-horizon glow. Compose an upbeat electronic track in Python, cut on the beats, and render 1920×1080 at 30 fps.

entries.title: Launch reference by @anshuc
entries.author: anshuc
entries.prompt_text: Design a mobile app prototype for {APP_NAME}, {ONE_LINE_PITCH}, whose screens feel like a desk of real correspondence: code-built 3D envelopes, folders and letters with paper grain, twine bows, wax seals and postage stamps that lift, open and unfold with fluid spring transitions. Build it as a web app with three.js for the paper objects and elegant serif type, then record a 25-second product demo inside an iPhone frame on a soft blue gradient at 2160×2160 using headless Chrome and ffmpeg.

entries.author: Miguel07Code
entries.prompt_text: Produce a 60-second launch video for {PRODUCT}, {ONE_LINE_PITCH}, with HyperFrames, writing each scene as an HTML composition and rendering it to MP4. entries.title: Launch reference by @anshuc
entries.author: anshuc
entries.prompt_text: Direct a 60-second Apple-style launch film for {APP_NAME} on a foldable phone, built in Blender through its Python API. Model the handset and three photoreal sets, a sunlit marble desk, a café table and a nightstand, light them with soft HDRIs, and animate the phone unfolding, propping into tent mode and rotating. Composite recordings of {APP_SCREEN_RECORDINGS} onto both displays, cut it together in code with match cuts and a clean end card, score it with an original piano-and-strings track, and render 1920×1080.

entries.title: Launch reference by @reg_andr
entries.author: reg_andr
entries.prompt_text: Produce a 50-second launch film for my Android app {APP_NAME} in Remotion. Capture real screen footage from a connected phone with adb screenrecord, after turning on demo mode so the status bar shows a clean clock and full battery. Place the clips inside a minimal off-white layout with a faint grid, corner crosshairs, a timecode and numbered chapter titles. Choose a track from {MUSIC_FOLDER}, detect its tempo, cut every transition on the beat and add subtle interface sound effects. 1920×1080 at 60 fps.

entries.title: Launch reference by @rameshsrivats

entries.prompt_text: Pitch an app idea, {APP_IDEA}, in a 26-second square concept video at 1080×1080, shown on an imagined foldable phone. Put a headline above the phone, write a calm piano accompaniment rendered from a free sample library, capture frames headlessly and encode with ffmpeg.

entries.title: Launch reference by @ai_for_success
entries.author: ai_for_success
entries.prompt_text: Build a Minecraft-style voxel sandbox in one HTML file with three.js, with procedurally generated terrain: snow-capped stone peaks, pine forests, rivers and caves. Then shoot a 60-second launch trailer inside the game for {GAME_NAME}: scripted fly-overs, a player mining and building, quick title cards and a logo ending. Capture at 1920×1080 with headless Chrome and encode with ffmpeg.

entries.title: Launch reference by @twoclipping
entries.author: twoclipping
entries.prompt_text: Design a 30-second square launch film for {BRAND}, an app that turns phone photos into framed prints, as one HTML file where each frame is computed purely from the timestamp. Tell it as a single unbroken shot on a creamy white background: a cursor clicks, drags and scrolls, and every screen reshapes into the next (photo grid, editor, phone, shop page, delivery tracker, print hanging on a wall). Use spring motion, frosted-glass panels and sound effects timed to {SONG_FILE}, then render 1440×1440 at 60 fps with Playwright and ffmpeg.
